description: This is a PHP source file that defines the EmployeeTimeAtWorkAPI class, part of the OrangeHRM dashboard API. It provides an endpoint to retrieve time at work data for an employee, supporting various query parameters such as date, time, and timezone. It includes API documentation annotations and leverages traits and external classes for authentication, date handling, and business logic.
